before: Draft status and responsible party
Who handles your information

This privacy notice is a draft for review. Verdant’s legal identity, trading name, business address and responsible-party details have not been confirmed for publication.

The Information Officer’s name and contact route also need owner confirmation. This page does not collect or forward a privacy request.

The operator of the Verdant store handles personal information collected through this website to provide the store and respond to your requests. Use the contact form for a privacy question or request.
body.after: The operator of the Verdant store handles personal information collected through this website to provide the store and respond to your requests. Use the contact form for a privacy question or request.

before: Information that may be involved
Information we handle

The application contains account, basket, checkout and order journeys. The exact personal information collected at each step, which fields are required or optional, and what is stored must be checked against the live application before this notice is final.

Verdant should also verify server logs, payment processing, delivery records and any enquiry handling before describing them as actual processing.

When you use the store, information associated with your account and activity can include your name and contact details, account credentials, order and rental details, selected compositions, and messages you send through the contact form. These records are stored in the application database.

The site uses session information to keep the relevant parts of your visit and account working.
body.after:
When you use the store, information associated with your account and activity can include your name and contact details, account credentials, order and rental details, selected compositions, and messages you send through the contact form. These records are stored in the application database.

The site uses session information to keep the relevant parts of your visit and account working.

before: Purposes and choices
How we use information

Before publication, Verdant must map each confirmed information item to its purpose and lawful basis, and explain which fields are necessary to provide a requested service.

Any marketing or other optional use must be described accurately, including how a person can make or withdraw a choice where that applies. The current application does not establish a newsletter subscription service.

We use account and contact details to provide account access, respond to support and privacy requests, and manage orders, rentals and compositions. Order and rental records help us provide the service you requested and keep the related transaction information.

We do not use the contact form as a newsletter subscription. Please include only information needed to handle your request.
body.after:
We use account and contact details to provide account access, respond to support and privacy requests, and manage orders, rentals and compositions. Order and rental records help us provide the service you requested and keep the related transaction information.

We do not use the contact form as a newsletter subscription. Please include only information needed to handle your request.

before: Recipients and international processing
Service providers and transfers

Payment providers, delivery partners, hosting providers and other recipients must be identified only after the actual integrations and contracts are checked. International access or storage also needs verification.

This draft does not claim that information is shared with any particular provider or transferred outside South Africa.

The application sends payment requests to Paystack in test mode. Payment card details are not stored in the Verdant application database.

Information may also be processed by the providers that host or operate the website and its database. Their identities, processing locations and any access from outside South Africa are not set out here.
body.after:
The application sends payment requests to Paystack. Payment card details are not stored in the Verdant application database.

Information may also be processed by the providers that host or operate the website and its database. Their identities, processing locations and any access from outside South Africa are not set out here.

before: Cookies and technical data

The actual cookies, logs and other tracking used by the deployed site have not been inventoried for this review. This notice makes no claim about analytics, advertising cookies or tracking technologies.

Confirm the technical inventory and each purpose before describing browser controls or consent choices.

The website uses session data to support account and store functions during your visit. Standard server and security records may also be created when the site is operated. This notice does not describe advertising or analytics tracking.
body.after: The website uses session data to support account and store functions during your visit. Standard server and security records may also be created when the site is operated. This notice does not describe advertising or analytics tracking.

before: Safeguards and retention
Access, storage and account records

Verdant must confirm the safeguards, authorised access, service providers and retention periods that apply to each system before publishing detailed promises.

Archiving an account is a reversible account-management action. It is different from a request to correct or delete personal information. A correction or deletion request must be assessed against applicable law, active transactions and records that must be retained.

Account, order, rental, composition and contact messages are stored in the application database. Administrator functions are restricted to role-authorised accounts.

Archiving an account is a reversible account-management action. It does not erase personal information or transaction records. We retain records as needed to operate the service and address related obligations; use the contact form to request access, correction or deletion so the request can be assessed.
body.after:
Account, order, rental, composition and contact messages are stored in the application database. Administrator functions are restricted to role-authorised accounts.

Archiving an account is a reversible account-management action. It does not erase personal information or transaction records. We retain records as needed to operate the service and address related obligations; use the contact form to request access, correction or deletion so the request can be assessed.

before:
Subject to POPIA and its conditions, a data subject may ask whether personal information is held and request access, correction or deletion where applicable. A person may also object to certain processing and withdraw consent where processing relies on consent.

A request must be handled through a verified route and assessed in context. This page does not submit a rights request, and it does not promise that every record can be erased immediately.

Subject to POPIA and its conditions, you may ask whether we hold personal information about you and request access to it. You may ask us to correct information that is inaccurate or incomplete, request deletion where applicable, object to certain processing, or withdraw consent where processing is based on your consent.

Use the contact form to make a privacy request. We may need to verify your identity and consider legal or transaction-record obligations before responding.

You may ask us to correct information that is inaccurate or incomplete, request deletion where applicable, object to certain processing, or withdraw consent where processing is based on your consent.

Use the contact form to make a privacy request. We may need to verify your identity and consider legal or transaction-record obligations before responding.
